gen-gf-baumans-gf-zalando-sans: Distinctive from the first glance, Baumans opens its c like a wrench and holds every stroke to a single thickness. Zalando Sans follows with approachable, open-ended curves that read easily page after page.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Wrench-wide curves and cable-steady strokes: that's Baumans, sitting over a sparse, widely spaced row of Zalando Sans Expanded. Reading it feels clean and unhurried, each letter given generous room.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpan: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded brings open-mouthed curves and a modern feel under Baumans, whose round letters have rims matching their stems. A display heading meeting a sans body is the standout.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: A crescent-wrench c, opened wide, gives Baumans its look. ZCOOL XiaoWei follows with mild stress in its o and e, so paragraphs of text move along smoothly with no ink pooling at the turns.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiqu: Baumans holds every stroke to one thickness, with a wrench-wide c. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique takes over below, modern and clean, its t matching crossbar to stem and its bends running smooth.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Wrench-wide curves and single-thickness lines make Baumans easy to spot at a glance. Zen Kaku Gothic New stays clear in its open-mouthed curves, and a slightly larger body size lets those hairline-free shapes breathe.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Professional ease: Zen Maru Gothic never once snags on closed bowls. Baumans, commanding with its wrench-wide c and single-thickness strokes, lands hard beside that smooth, single thread of easy reading.
gen-gf-bellota-clash-grotesk: Distinctive Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, every stroke traced at stylus width. Clash Grotesk below has no stroke modulation at all, clean and approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-alpino: Alpino is cozy and casual, with a tall body and short-looking ascenders. Bellota is best at a gentle, monotone line, while Alpino is best at tight spacing with curve endings kept apart.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-akatab: A far-hung s with spine and terminals alike in thickness: Bellota. Akatab follows with cupped, approachable, neutral round letters, while Bellota does the display work and Akatab does the reading.
